integrity: Analytic all-parameter argument and standalone rational-arithmetic stress tests. Self-review only; no independent scientific validation.
scientific_limitations: Deterministic fixed-growth Beverton-Holt equation with exactly two copies each of two distinct capacities in four seasons. Convex order applies to inverse abundance, not abundance. No stochastic or empirical extension is claimed. Equivalent prior rearrangement formulations remain possible.
title: A four-season convex-order law for clustered versus alternating carrying capacities
